sub_sector.value: Architectural systems; well perforating systems; clad metals

manufacturing_type.detail: Fabricates architectural systems, assembles well perforating systems, and produces explosion-welded clad metals.

production_model.detail: Arcadia supplies custom windows, doors, and interior architectural framing systems.

product_complexity.detail: Custom architectural systems address energy efficiency, noise control, and fire ratings alongside engineered well completion and composite metal products.

production_role.detail: Supplies finished architectural and well perforating systems, perforating components, and clad metal plate.

end_market_exposure.detail: Commercial and luxury residential construction, oil and gas well completions, and industrial applications.

notes: Arcadia offers custom products, but stocking practices across the group are unclear.
